title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - ResourceUsage
description: An occurrence of usage on a Resource,derived from various Service usages. It is comprised of characteristics, which represent attributes of service usage. (TM Forum TMF771 Resource Usage Management 5.0.0, OpenAPI component ResourceUsage; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:ResourceUsage:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ResourceUsage'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF771_ResourceUsage/blob/v5.0.0/TMF771-Resource_Usage_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'ResourceUsage' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF771_ResourceUsage/blob/v5.0.0/TMF771-Resource_Usage_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF771_ResourceUsage/blob/v5.0.0/TMF771-Resource_Usage_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF771_ResourceUsage/blob/v5.0.0/TMF771-Resource_Usage_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Addressable/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:ResourceUsage:<tmfId>. unique identifier

isBundle.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF771_ResourceUsage/blob/v5.0.0/TMF771-Resource_Usage_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ResourceUsage/properties/isBundle'. isBundle determines whether usage represents a single usage (false), or a bundle of usages specifications (true).

usageCharacteristic.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF771_ResourceUsage/blob/v5.0.0/TMF771-Resource_Usage_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ResourceUsage/properties/usageCharacteristic'. Describes a given characteristic of an object or entity through a name/value pair. This is an abstract base class, the actual value is in one of the strongly-typed subclasses : StringCharacteristic, ObjectCharacteristic, FloatCharacteristic, BooleanCharacteristic, NumberCharacteristic, IntegerCharacteristic, StringArrayCharacteristic, ObjectArrayCharacteristic, BooleanArrayCharacteristic, NumberArrayCharacteristic, IntegerArrayCharacteristic...

relatedParty.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF771_ResourceUsage/blob/v5.0.0/TMF771-Resource_Usage_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ResourceUsage/properties/relatedParty'. RelatedParty reference. A related party defines party or party role or its reference, linked to a specific entity

resource.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF771_ResourceUsage/blob/v5.0.0/TMF771-Resource_Usage_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ResourceUsage/properties/resource'. Resource reference, for when Resource is used by other entities. In TMF this is a ResourceRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced Resource entity (urn:ngsi-ld:Resource:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

usageSpecification.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF771_ResourceUsage/blob/v5.0.0/TMF771-Resource_Usage_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ResourceUsage/properties/usageSpecification'. ResourceUsageSpecification reference. ResourceUsageSpecification is a detailed description of a usage event that are of interest to the business and can have charges applied to it. It is comprised of characteristics, which define all attributes known for a particular type of usage. In TMF this is a ResourceUsageSpecificationRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced ResourceUsageSpecification entity (urn:ngsi-ld:ResourceUsageSpecification:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

bundledResourceUsage.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF771_ResourceUsage/blob/v5.0.0/TMF771-Resource_Usage_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ResourceUsage/properties/bundledResourceUsage'. Relationship to Resource Usage in bundle. In TMF this is an array of ResourceUsageRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced ResourceUsage entities (urn:ngsi-ld:ResourceUsage:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

externalIdentifier.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF771_ResourceUsage/blob/v5.0.0/TMF771-Resource_Usage_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/ResourceUsage/properties/externalIdentifier'. A list of external identifiers assoicated with this resource usage

The value is given by the sub-class named in @type (discriminator in the TMF specification): StringCharacteristic; see $defs.

allOf.description: An identification of an entity that is owned by or originates in a software system different from the current system, for example a ProductOrder handed off from a commerce platform into an order handling system. The structure identifies the system itself, the nature of the entity within the system (e.g. class name) and the unique ID of the entity within the system. It is anticipated that multiple external IDs can be held for a single entity, e.g. if the entity passed through multiple systems on the way to the current system. In this case the consumer is expected to sequence the IDs in the array in reverse order of provenance, i.e. most recent system first in the list.

owner.description: Name of the external system that owns the entity.

externalIdentifierType.description: Type of the identification, typically would be the type of the entity within the external system

id.description: identification of the entity within the external system.

allOf.description: Party role reference. A party role represents the part played by a party in a given context.

partyId.description: The identifier of the engaged party that is linked to the PartyRole object.

partyName.description: The name of the engaged party that is linked to the PartyRole object.

allOf.description: RelatedParty reference. A related party defines party or party role or its reference, linked to a specific entity

role.description: Role played by the related party or party role in the context of the specific entity it is linked to. Such as 'initiator', 'customer', 'salesAgent', 'user'

allOf.description: A characteristic which value is a String.
